target: Time-resolved APAP and cholestatic injury, intervention, washout, recovery, and fate observations in primary human hepatocytes
record_granularity: One raw endpoint observation for one identified donor, biological replicate, condition, and time point

required_columns.reason: Stable row identity and duplicate detection
Predeclared calibration, internal-validation, or independent-heldout assignment
Exact table, figure, supplement, repository, or raw-file location
Cross-species records must not enter the human calibration set
Fresh PHH, plated PHH, sandwich culture, spheroid, and cell-line contexts are not interchangeable
Culture geometry and medium context affect exposure and response
The measured biological quantity or fate label
Aggregate prose cannot identify donor trajectories
Replicates must not be mistaken for independent donors
Per-cell, per-protein, per-well, and medium-volume outputs are not interchangeable
Below-quantification and saturated measurements must remain explicit

conditional_columns.required_when: A rescue, inhibitor, sensitizer, or co-treatment is present
Challenge or intervention washout is performed
Only a summary statistic rather than raw replicate value is available
Only a summary statistic rather than raw replicate value is available
The assay reports an LLOQ or censoring
The output is normalized by seeded or viable cell count
